name: TC-351: the table renders the seeded deals cell-for-cell and the stat cards equal the page's own list response
description: For API-seeded deals the row shows: name, 'N items' (qty-1 slots), $deal + struck $original, 'X% off' (0 dp), restrictions ('All days'/'All day' or 'Mon, Wed' + '11:00 - 14:00'), the status badge, and '0 times'. Stat cards Total/Active Deals equal the counts in the GET /api/deals/restaurant/:id response the page itself received (concurrency-safe).
